question.problem: What is the solution to the equation $0.9s=3.6?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we multiply both sides of the equation by $10$ to get rid of the decimals:

$$
\begin{aligned}0.9s & =3.6 \\ 10\cdot (0.9s) & =10\cdot (3.6) \\ 9s & =36\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve the equation using the multiplication principle, as usual:

$$
\begin{aligned}9s & =36 \\ \frac{9s}{9} & =\frac{36}{9} \\ \frac{\cancel{9}s}{\cancel{9}} & =\frac{36}{9} \\ s & =4\end{aligned}
$$
